name: core-far-land
description: The land beyond the walkable edge, out to ~2.3 km: coarse low-poly ground painted from data (salt flats, beaches, scrub bands, washes, deltas, playa), roads with lines and pole lines, and a sea at a level. Place once at the world centre (no name needed); it replaces the green horizon ring. Nothing on it is walkable.

radius.doc: outer reach from the entity (m); the view ends near 2.1 km from the camera

ground.doc: base colour beyond the edge (default: the terrain palette at the edge)

areas.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], m:"salt"|…|c:"#hex", edge?:m, shrubs?:per-ha}] polygons, painted in order

strips.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], w:m, m|c, edge?, shrubs?}] polylines with a width (washes, bands, tracks, beaches)

roads.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], w?:12, lines?:true, poles?:{side:1|-1, every:60, h:10}}] asphalt with centre and edge lines, gravel shoulders

sea.doc: {pts:[[x,z]…], level?:-1 (m from base), c?:"#hex", beach?:m} water polygon (may reach far past the radius)

name: core-panorama
description: Far mountain ranges at their real distances (5–50 km) around the horizon, hazed by the air, with far water to the horizon where there is a sea or lake. Bearings in compass degrees (0 = north = -z). Follows the camera like a sky; place once at the world centre (no name needed); it replaces the green horizon ring.

ranges.doc: [{from:°, to:°, d:m, h:m, rough?:0..1, c:"#hex", c2?:"#hex" (strata), bands?:0..1, haze?:mult, foothills?:0..1, seed?, profile?:[0..1…]}] bearings clockwise from north

water.doc: {from:°, to:°, c?:"#hex", far?:"#hex"} far water from the near shore to the horizon

ground.doc: below-horizon skirt where no water is (default: the terrain palette's plain)

visibility.doc: distance (m) at which the air hides ~63% of a far range
